headline: Head of Partnerships, Martech & Data | $18M partner-sourced pipeline | Agency, ISV & AWS Marketplace ecosystems | New York and Paris
about:
I build partner programs that become a revenue line. At Northwind Data I started the technology partner program from zero: 35 ISV integrations in 2 years and $18M in partner-sourced pipeline in FY2025, 22% of new business.

Before that I sat on the other side of the table. At Quillfeather Media I managed 6 holding-company agencies representing $40M in annual media spend, negotiated 3 multi-year agency deals worth $12M combined, and launched a co-marketing fund that produced 140 joint campaigns. My first partnership job was in Paris, growing a reseller channel across 12 French and Belgian partners from €1.2M to €3.4M.

What I bring to a martech or data platform: partner programs designed from scratch, agency and ISV relationships that carry a number, and the habit of building my own tools — I wrote the AI account-planning assistant my partner team uses every week.

Native French, fluent English.
